coreCategoryObjections.strongestReasonBelowThree: Command W02 removes its tall aerials and flags; from the front it can be confused with an ordinary Comet wreck. All exact conversion layouts are invented rather than historical identification cues.

resolutionEvidence.observation: Resolved at static source-family scope with advisory. Compared accepted base W02 rear-right and command W02 rear-right: one green bustle block versus paired collapsed dark cases plus cable reel remains a deliberate distinction. The clean command also has tall aerials versus base short stubs. Wreck controls are disabled; a wreck is not required to advertise operational command functionality. OP short gun/head and Crocodile essential trailer distinguish their packages at native256. Front-only gameplay recognition remains weaker and is not claimed qualified.

coreCategoryObjections.strongestReasonBelowThree: Fine antennas/reels disappear or merge in front/top views; trailer tyres could dominate the body; displaced W03 assemblies can be confusing.

resolutionEvidence.observation: Resolved for source artwork. Primary Comet silhouette is preserved; clean OP short barrel/head and trailer negative space remain distinct; r3 tyre detail is subordinate. Wreck displacement and missing/failed running gear form three different state families. No new silhouette clipping observed in full required diagnostics. Local equipment closeups deliberately crop context and are not full-view proof.

coreCategoryObjections.strongestReasonBelowThree: The r3 wheel/rubber crossings were actual bad interfaces; poles could float after rack collapse; buried coax closures and a solid projector could contradict their intended function. Sampled motion can miss contact failures.

resolutionEvidence.observation: Resolved within bounded source-artwork evidence: fit2 removes all four tyre/body+lid pairs; cross-bustle clamps rest on clean rack; poles absent collapsed-rack wrecks; visible OP coax closure, dummy barrel and projector opening are coherent. The current report covers turret/hatches/gun/optic samples and171trailer poses. Service/linkage reports zero hitch pivot separation and clear straight-lift new-equipment envelope. Exact interlocks, neutral locked projector, terrain-appropriate trailer tilt and disabled wreck controls remain required. No continuous, dynamic, ergonomic or real-operability certification.

coreCategoryObjections.strongestReasonBelowThree: Mixed r2/r3 identities, stale sheets and unrecorded mount scaling could bind the reviewer to a model different from the delivered recipes.

resolutionEvidence.observation: Resolved for the assessed files:32r2+12r3 identities retained explicitly;1642independent exact selected mesh/accessor comparisons and file hashes pass; all21direct-base selections agree without duplicate selected parts; all203full and168thumbnail receipt image/assembly/manifest hashes match current bytes; sheets now current. Fit2 scaling appears explicitly in every applicable wheel mount. Final guide and primary evaluator records are outside this independent artifact verdict and must bind these same manifests.
